description: Transport en commun - Arrêt is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Rouyn-Noranda. Ensemble des arrêts du réseau de transport en commun géré par la Ville de Rouyn-Noranda. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Rouyn-Noranda. Its tags are Abri, Arrêt, Autobus, Bus, Collectif. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, ESRIREST, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2025-09-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
